summary: Open Core is running: 83 successful analyses, fresh reputation, and Astra balance 10.5 matching the collaborative score. Layer 1 stays disabled; this pass must not flip that gate. The live problem is noise: no open PRs and seven dated analysis issues, six already superseded by later commits. Presence still shows 82 analyses from 2026-11-09, and queue notes still cite 61 analyses from 2026-10-08.
stop: Stop opening another dated analysis issue while 251 and 253–257 stay open.
start: Close those six superseded issues and land one human PR that refreshes presence and queue notes to usage 83.
keep: Keep Astra at 10.5 derived from collaborative reputation, and keep it from gating Open Core.
